"""Conscious: a tiny journaling/reflection CLI that tags mood and suggests next actions (rule-based prototype)."""

    tip={"positive":"Capture what worked; repeat it tomorrow.","negative":"Take a walk, then pick one small task.","neutral":"Set one clear goal for today."}[mood]

# Conscious
AI reflection platform prototype. Run: python app.py 'feeling stressed but excited'

## Features
- mood tagging + next-action tip
- `python report.py` summarizes your mood history
Roadmap: LLM-based reflection, streaks, weekly insights.

## CivicHack angle
Community wellbeing check-ins: anonymous mood logs from a neighborhood/school can be aggregated with `report.py` to show where support is needed. Privacy-first: local-only log file, no accounts.
"""Conscious: a tiny journaling/reflection CLI that tags mood and suggests next actions (rule-based prototype)."""
import sys, json, datetime
POS={"happy","great","excited","proud","calm","good"}
NEG={"sad","tired","anxious","stressed","angry","bad"}
def analyze(t):
    toks=t.lower().split(); s=0
    for i,x in enumerate(toks):
        v=(x in POS)-(x in NEG)
        if i and toks[i-1] in {'not','never',"isn't","not"}: v=-v
        s+=v
    mood="positive" if s>0 else "negative" if s<0 else "neutral"
    tip={"positive":"Capture what worked; repeat it tomorrow.","negative":"Take a walk, then pick one small task.","neutral":"Set one clear goal for today."}[mood]
    return {"time":datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),"text":t,"mood":mood,"tip":tip}
if __name__=="__main__":
    r=analyze(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) or "neutral day"); print(json.dumps(r,indent=1))
    open("log.jsonl","a").write(json.dumps(r)+"\n")
"""Weekly mood report from log.jsonl: counts, streak, trend, suggestion"""
import json,collections,datetime
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open("log.jsonl")]
c=collections.Counter(r["mood"] for r in rows)
print("entries:",len(rows),dict(c))
days=sorted({r["time"][:10] for r in rows})
streak=0;d=datetime.date.today()
while d.isoformat() in days: streak+=1;d-=datetime.timedelta(days=1)
print("journaling streak (days):",streak)
sc={"positive":1,"neutral":0,"negative":-1}
v=[sc[r["mood"]] for r in rows]
h=v[-7:];p=v[-14:-7]
if p: print("trend vs prior 7:",sum(h)/len(h)-sum(p)/len(p))
print("tip:", "Mostly low lately: schedule rest + one win." if sum(h)<0 else "Keep the habit going.")
from app import analyze
assert analyze("happy and proud")["mood"]=="positive"
assert analyze("tired stressed")["mood"]=="negative"
assert analyze("ok")["mood"]=="neutral"
print("ok")
def test_negation():
    from app import analyze
    assert analyze("not happy")["mood"]=="negative"

# Conscious
AI reflection platform prototype. Run: python app.py 'feeling stressed but excited'

## Features
- mood tagging + next-action tip
- `python report.py` summarizes your mood history
Roadmap: LLM-based reflection, streaks, weekly insights.

## CivicHack angle
Community wellbeing check-ins: anonymous mood logs from a neighborhood/school can be aggregated with `report.py` to show where support is needed. Privacy-first: local-only log file, no accounts.

## How the mood score works
Keyword-based tagging (positive/neutral/negative) from your text. Score: +1/0/-1 per entry; trend = avg of last 7 vs prior 7.

## Data & privacy
Stored only in local log.jsonl on your machine. No accounts, no network, nobody else can see it. Not for minors' data without guardian consent.
"""Conscious: a tiny journaling/reflection CLI that tags mood and suggests next actions (rule-based prototype)."""
import sys, json, datetime
POS={"happy","great","excited","proud","calm","good"}
NEG={"sad","tired","anxious","stressed","angry","bad"}
def analyze(t):
    toks=t.lower().split(); s=0
    for i,x in enumerate(toks):
        v=(x in POS)-(x in NEG)
        if i and toks[i-1] in {'not','never',"isn't","not"}: v=-v
        s+=v
    mood="positive" if s>0 else "negative" if s<0 else "neutral"
    tip={"positive":"Capture what worked; repeat it tomorrow.","negative":"Take a walk, then pick one small task.","neutral":"Set one clear goal for today."}[mood]
    return {"time":datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),"text":t,"mood":mood,"tip":tip}
if __name__=="__main__":
    r=analyze(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) or "neutral day"); print(json.dumps(r,indent=1))
    open("log.jsonl","a").write(json.dumps(r)+"\n")
"""Weekly mood report from log.jsonl: counts, streak, trend, suggestion"""
import json,collections,datetime
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open("log.jsonl")]
c=collections.Counter(r["mood"] for r in rows)
print("entries:",len(rows),dict(c))
days=sorted({r["time"][:10] for r in rows})
streak=0;d=datetime.date.today()
while d.isoformat() in days: streak+=1;d-=datetime.timedelta(days=1)
print("journaling streak (days):",streak)
sc={"positive":1,"neutral":0,"negative":-1}
v=[sc[r["mood"]] for r in rows]
h=v[-7:];p=v[-14:-7]
if p: print("trend vs prior 7:",sum(h)/len(h)-sum(p)/len(p))
print("tip:", "Mostly low lately: schedule rest + one win." if sum(h)<0 else "Keep the habit going.")
print("entries in latest 7 window:")
for r in rows[-7:]: print(" ",r["time"][:10],r["mood"],"|",str(r.get("text",""))[:60])

# Conscious
AI reflection platform prototype. Run: python app.py 'feeling stressed but excited'

## Features
- mood tagging + next-action tip
- `python report.py` summarizes your mood history
Roadmap: LLM-based reflection, streaks, weekly insights.

## CivicHack angle
Community wellbeing check-ins: anonymous mood logs from a neighborhood/school can be aggregated with `report.py` to show where support is needed. Privacy-first: local-only log file, no accounts.

## How the mood score works
Keyword-based tagging (positive/neutral/negative) from your text. Score: +1/0/-1 per entry; trend = avg of last 7 vs prior 7.

## Data & privacy
Stored only in local log.jsonl on your machine. No accounts, no network, nobody else can see it. Not for minors' data without guardian consent.

## Hack Night update
Report now prints the check-in text behind every number, so no score appears without context. Tags are keyword-based and shown beside the full entry, never as a label on a person.
